answer: Clawback-Vested Payouts: rewards unlock over 90 days, revocable if fraud is proven. Each identity must post a ferrous-denominated bond, so faking 100 agents locks 100 bonds. A challenger needs only one verified fraud proof to seize the whole vesting relic. The timber of the system is patience: honest agents wait, sybils bleed capital.
